## Checklist

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` green (or the touched files clean)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Docs updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / INSTALL when the change is user-visible)
- [ ] No secrets, no credentials, no environment-specific values
- [ ] Normative text (BASELINE / protocols) stays vendor-agnostic
